## 现有大纲 manifest

```json
{
  "head": "f36aec822be697df9049fed020b593147c93b4cf",
  "project": "zed-crates-sidebar",
  "rationale": "增量分析结论：上次 HEAD 907ed09c 到当前 HEAD f36aec822 之间共有 7 个提交，其中零个提交触及 crates/sidebar，sidebar.rs、sidebar_tests.rs、thread_switcher.rs 与 Cargo.toml 完全无 diff；讲义引用的外部文件中 multi_workspace.rs、threads_archive_view.rs、agent_ui/test_support.rs 也零变化。唯一被引用且发生变化的是 crates/zed/src/zed.rs（提交 107ee1a60a，仅 6 行）：initialize_panels 中 initialize_agent_panel 改为传入 workspace_handle.clone()，并在面板初始化后显式调用 finish_dock_restoration。该改动位于 zed.rs:808 之后，使 u1-l1 中引用的 zed.rs:L912（register_actions）与 L1427（dump_workspace_info 注册）漂移为 L916/L1431，但 Sidebar::new 的装配主链路（zed.rs:538-548）与 crate 内全部源码未受影响，因此 u1-l1 只需小幅修订（更新行号并把永久链接重新钉到新 HEAD），u1-l2、u1-l3、u2-l1 三篇已生成讲义涉及的文件零变化、保持 keep；其余 18 篇讲义尚未生成，保持 new 以便 worker 按原计划继续生成，整体学习路线（先跑起来、再读数据模型、沿数据流自上游到下游、再到跨视图行为与生命周期、最后测试与可观测性）无需调整。",
  "units": [
    {
      "id": "u1",
      "lectures": [
        {
          "action": "update",
          "depends_on": [],
          "filename": "u1-l1-project-overview.md",
          "id": "u1-l1",
          "learning_goals": [
            "说出 sidebar crate 在 Zed 中的角色与三大源码文件各自职责",
            "从 Cargo.toml 依赖推断它与其他 crate（agent_ui、workspace、project、git_ui_core）的边界",
            "在 zed.rs 中找到 Sidebar 的创建与注册点"
          ],
          "level": "beginner",
          "minimal_modules": [
            "Cargo.toml 依赖",
            "Sidebar::new",
            "MultiWorkspace::register_sidebar"
          ],
          "order": 1,
          "practice_task": "在本机克隆 Zed 仓库后运行 cargo tree -p sidebar --depth 1，列出 sidebar 直接依赖的所有 zed 内部 crate，并在 sidebar.rs 的 use 区段为每个依赖找到至少一处真实使用点，写一份依赖-用途对照表。",
          "source_files": [
            "crates/sidebar/Cargo.toml",
            "crates/sidebar/src/sidebar.rs",
            "crates/zed/src/zed.rs"
          ],
          "title": "项目定位与整体结构：sidebar crate 是什么",
          "topic": "介绍 sidebar crate 在 Zed 中的定位（多项目 Agent 线程与终端侧边栏）、三个源文件的分工、Cargo.toml 中的关键依赖，以及它在 zed crate 中被装配的位置。"
        },
        {
          "action": "keep",
          "depends_on": [
            "u1-l1"
          ],
          "filename": "u1-l2-build-and-test.md",
          "id": "u1-l2",
          "learning_goals": [
            "掌握 sidebar crate 的构建与测试命令",
            "理解 #[gpui::test] 异步测试的基本形态",
            "知道如何挑选并单独运行一个测试"
          ],
          "level": "beginner",
          "minimal_modules": [
            "cargo test -p sidebar",
            "TestAppContext",
            "setup_sidebar"
          ],
          "order": 2,
          "practice_task": "运行 cargo test -p sidebar --lib test_single_workspace_no_threads，再任选一个归档相关测试单独运行，记录命令与输出；然后故意在本地把 sidebar.rs 中一个常量改错（如 DEFAULT_WIDTH）观察哪些测试失败，最后还原。",
          "source_files": [
            "crates/sidebar/Cargo.toml",
            "crates/sidebar/src/sidebar_tests.rs"
          ],
          "title": "构建、运行与测试：让 crate 跑起来",
          "topic": "讲解如何构建和测试 sidebar crate，介绍 gpui 测试的基本形态，以及通过 visual_test_runner 观察 UI 的途径。"
        },
        {
          "action": "keep",
          "depends_on": [
            "u1-l1"
          ],
          "filename": "u1-l3-sidebar-struct-lifecycle.md",
          "id": "u1-l3",
          "learning_goals": [
            "梳理 Sidebar 结构体 30 余个字段各自承担的状态",
            "列出 Sidebar::new 注册的全部订阅与观察者",
            "理解 WeakEntity 与 defer_in 在初始化中的作用"
          ],
          "level": "beginner",
          "minimal_modules": [
            "Sidebar::new",
            "cx.subscribe_in",
            "cx.observe",
            "cx.defer_in"
          ],
          "order": 3,
          "practice_task": "通读 Sidebar::new（sidebar.rs:795 起），手绘一张『事件源 → 订阅回调 → 副作用』表，涵盖 MultiWorkspace、filter_editor、ThreadMetadataStore、TerminalThreadMetadataStore 等全部事件源，并标注哪些订阅在构造时注册、哪些延迟到 defer_in 中注册。",
          "source_files": [
            "crates/sidebar/src/sidebar.rs",
            "crates/workspace/src/multi_workspace.rs"
          ],
          "title": "Sidebar 实体：字段全景与构造生命周期",
          "topic": "逐组解读 Sidebar 结构体的字段（宽度、焦点、过滤器、列表状态、选中/活跃、重命名、切换器、缓存与订阅），并走读 Sidebar::new 中注册的所有订阅。"
        }
      ],
      "level": "beginner",
      "order": 1,
      "title": "单元一：初识 sidebar crate"
    },
    {
      "id": "u2",
      "lectures": [
        {
          "action": "keep",
          "depends_on": [
            "u1-l3"
          ],
          "filename": "u2-l1-list-entry-model.md",
          "id": "u2-l1",
          "learning_goals": [
            "区分三种 ListEntry 变体的字段与用途",
            "说明 SidebarContents 中通知集合与项目头索引的作用",
            "理解 From<ThreadEntry> 等转换如何让行构造统一"
          ],
          "level": "beginner",
          "minimal_modules": [
            "ListEntry",
            "ThreadEntry",
            "TerminalEntry",
            "SidebarContents"
          ],
          "order": 1,
          "practice_task": "为 ThreadEntry 的每个字段写一句注释说明它由哪个数据源填充（数据库元数据、活跃线程信息、特性开关等），并对照 rebuild_contents 中构造 ThreadEntry 的代码验证你的判断。",
          "source_files": [
            "crates/sidebar/src/sidebar.rs"
          ],
          "title": "列表行模型：ListEntry、ThreadEntry 与 TerminalEntry",
          "topic": "讲解侧边栏列表的三种行（项目分组头、线程、终端）以及承载它们的 SidebarContents 结构，这是理解后续重建与渲染的基础。"
        },
        {
          "action": "new",
          "depends_on": [
            "u2-l1"
          ],
          "filename": "u2-l2-workspace-and-groups.md",
          "id": "u2-l2",
          "learning_goals": [
            "区分工作区『打开/关闭』两种形态对行渲染的影响",
            "说明 ProjectGroupKey 如何决定分组与折叠",
            "理解 linked worktree 路径如何被收集进侧边栏"
          ],
          "level": "intermediate",
          "minimal_modules": [
            "ThreadEntryWorkspace",
            "ProjectGroupKey",
            "PathList",
            "root_repository_snapshots"
          ],
          "order": 2,
          "practice_task": "跟踪 workspace_path_list、root_repository_snapshots、linked_worktree_path_lists_for_workspaces 三个函数的调用链，画出一个多根工作区（含 linked worktree）如何映射为若干 PathList 并最终变成 Closed 条目的示意图。",
          "source_files": [
            "crates/sidebar/src/sidebar.rs",
            "crates/workspace/src/multi_workspace.rs"
          ],
          "title": "工作区与项目分组：ThreadEntryWorkspace 与 ProjectGroupKey",
          "topic": "讲解 ThreadEntryWorkspace 的 Open/Closed 两种形态、ProjectGroupKey 分组键、PathList 路径匹配，以及 linked worktree 与远程连接的判定。"
        },
        {
          "action": "new",
          "depends_on": [
            "u2-l1"
          ],
          "filename": "u2-l3-active-vs-selection.md",
          "id": "u2-l3",
          "learning_goals": [
            "区分 selection（键盘焦点索引）与 active_entry（当前活跃条目）",
            "理解 session_id 在跨窗口激活时的稳定匹配作用",
            "掌握 matches_entry 的匹配规则"
          ],
          "level": "intermediate",
          "minimal_modules": [
            "ActiveEntry",
            "selection",
            "matches_entry",
            "is_active_workspace"
          ],
          "order": 3,
          "practice_task": "阅读 ActiveEntry 的三个判定方法与 sync_active_entry_from_panel、sync_active_entry_from_active_workspace，写一段文字解释『为什么跨窗口激活后 thread_id 会变而 session_id 不变』，并指出 matches_entry 中体现这一点的代码行。",
          "source_files": [
            "crates/sidebar/src/sidebar.rs"
          ],
          "title": "选中与活跃：selection、ActiveEntry 与身份匹配",
          "topic": "辨析两个容易混淆的概念——键盘选中的列表下标 selection 与全局高亮的 ActiveEntry，并讲解 session_id 在 thread_id 变化时的稳定匹配作用。"
        }
      ],
      "level": "beginner",
      "order": 2,
      "title": "单元二：列表数据模型"
    },
    {
      "id": "u3",
      "lectures": [
        {
          "action": "new",
          "depends_on": [
            "u1-l3",
            "u2-l1"
          ],
          "filename": "u3-l1-subscription-network.md",
          "id": "u3-l1",
          "learning_goals": [
            "列出触发侧边栏刷新的全部事件源",
            "理解 move_entry_paths 如何同步路径变更到两个元数据存储",
            "说明草稿编辑器观察链为何需要重建"
          ],
          "level": "intermediate",
          "minimal_modules": [
            "subscribe_to_workspace",
            "subscribe_to_agent_panel",
            "refresh_draft_editor_observations",
            "move_entry_paths"
          ],
          "order": 1,
          "practice_task": "从 ProjectEvent::WorktreePathsChanged 出发，跟踪 move_entry_paths 如何调用 ThreadMetadataStore 与 TerminalThreadMetadataStore 的 change_worktree_paths，写出行数据路径迁移的时序说明；再解释 refresh_draft_editor_observations 为何要在每次 update_entries 后重连订阅。",
          "source_files": [
            "crates/sidebar/src/sidebar.rs"
          ],
          "title": "事件订阅网络：谁在通知侧边栏刷新",
          "topic": "系统梳理 subscribe_to_workspace（ProjectEvent、GitStoreEvent、PanelAdded）、subscribe_to_agent_panel（AgentPanelEvent）以及对两个元数据 Store 的 observe，说明每类事件触发的行为。"
        },
        {
          "action": "new",
          "depends_on": [
            "u3-l1"
          ],
          "filename": "u3-l2-update-pipeline.md",
          "id": "u3-l2",
          "learning_goals": [
            "理解 update_task 对重复刷新的合并策略",
            "按顺序说出 update_entries 的五个步骤",
            "理解『每次全量重推导』这一架构约束的含义"
          ],
          "level": "intermediate",
          "minimal_modules": [
            "schedule_update_entries",
            "update_entries",
            "update_task",
            "cx.notify"
          ],
          "order": 2,
          "practice_task": "在 update_entries 中为每个步骤加一条日志（通过 log::info!），运行任一列表相关测试并对照输出还原调用顺序；然后写一段说明：为什么 Sidebar 结构体上的 doc comment 要求『不要在事件间添加增量协调状态』。",
          "source_files": [
            "crates/sidebar/src/sidebar.rs"
          ],
          "title": "重建管线：schedule_update_entries → update_entries",
          "topic": "讲解刷新的合并与调度机制：update_task 如何去抖、select_first_after_update 的语义，以及 update_entries 依次执行的重建、草稿刷新、差异应用与预取步骤。"
        },
        {
          "action": "new",
          "depends_on": [
            "u3-l2",
            "u2-l1"
          ],
          "filename": "u3-l3-entry-shape-diff.md",
          "id": "u3-l3",
          "learning_goals": [
            "理解 EntryShape 作为『等高行』身份键的设计",
            "读懂 apply_list_state_diff 的前缀/后缀对齐算法",
            "说明为什么状态更新不应重置列表测量"
          ],
          "level": "intermediate",
          "minimal_modules": [
            "EntryShape",
            "apply_list_state_diff",
            "ListState::splice",
            "entry_shapes"
          ],
          "order": 3,
          "practice_task": "手动模拟一次差异计算：给定 previous_shapes = [A,B,C,D] 与新序列 [A,X,C,D]，按 apply_list_state_diff 的逻辑推出 prefix_len、suffix_len 与最终 splice 参数；再运行 test_thread_metadata_update_preserves_sticky_header_measurements 验证理解。",
          "source_files": [
            "crates/sidebar/src/sidebar.rs",
            "crates/sidebar/src/sidebar_tests.rs"
          ],
          "title": "EntryShape 与 apply_list_state_diff：保留列表测量值",
          "topic": "讲解列表身份键 EntryShape 的设计动机与 apply_list_state_diff 的前后缀比对算法，理解为什么只拼接变化区间能避免粘性头部闪烁。"
        },
        {
          "action": "new",
          "depends_on": [
            "u3-l2",
            "u2-l2"
          ],
          "filename": "u3-l4-rebuild-contents.md",
          "id": "u3-l4",
          "learning_goals": [
            "理解 rebuild_contents 从项目分组出发的全量推导过程",
            "说明终端元数据的多路查询与 seen_terminal_ids 去重",
            "理解路径消歧与分支名映射如何影响行展示"
          ],
          "level": "intermediate",
          "minimal_modules": [
            "rebuild_contents",
            "entries_for_main_worktree_path / entries_for_path",
            "compute_disambiguation_details",
            "apply_active_info"
          ],
          "order": 4,
          "practice_task": "给 rebuild_contents 的主要阶段（分组遍历、终端收集、线程收集、草屑判定、排序与过滤）绘制流程图，标注每个阶段读取的全局 Store；并用 test_terminal_metadata_is_deduped_across_project_groups 验证你对去重逻辑的理解。",
          "source_files": [
            "crates/sidebar/src/sidebar.rs"
          ],
          "title": "rebuild_contents 全景：从项目分组到可见行",
          "topic": "深入本 crate 最长的核心函数：项目分组遍历、终端元数据的多路查询与去重、路径消歧、分支名映射、活跃线程信息合并、草稿可见性判定与搜索过滤。"
        }
      ],
      "level": "intermediate",
      "order": 3,
      "title": "单元三：数据流与重建管线"
    },
    {
      "id": "u4",
      "lectures": [
        {
          "action": "new",
          "depends_on": [
            "u3-l2"
          ],
          "filename": "u4-l1-render-skeleton.md",
          "id": "u4-l1",
          "learning_goals": [
            "掌握 Sidebar::render 的整体分区（头部、列表、空态、底部栏）",
            "理解客户端装饰下侧边栏的定位与圆角处理",
            "区分 ThreadList 与 Archive 两种视图的渲染分支"
          ],
          "level": "intermediate",
          "minimal_modules": [
            "Render::render",
            "render_sidebar_header",
            "render_sidebar_bottom_bar",
            "WindowBackgroundAppearance/Decorations"
          ],
          "order": 1,
          "practice_task": "将 render() 的链式调用改写为带缩进的伪代码树（本地练习，不必提交），标出每个 .when/.map 分支的触发条件；再解释 no_open_projects 与 no_search_results 两个布尔量分别控制哪个替代视图。",

            "crates/sidebar/src/sidebar.rs"
          ],
          "title": "渲染主骨架：Render for Sidebar",
          "topic": "走读 render() 的整体布局：标题栏混合背景、粘性头部、gpui list 虚拟列表、空态/无结果覆盖层、导入横幅与底部栏，以及客户端窗口装饰下的圆角与 1px 外扩技巧。"
        },
        {
          "action": "new",
          "depends_on": [
            "u4-l1",
            "u2-l2"
          ],
          "filename": "u4-l2-project-header-sticky.md",
          "id": "u4-l2",
          "learning_goals": [
            "理解项目分组头的组成元素与状态徽标",
            "理解折叠状态存放在 MultiWorkspace 而非 Sidebar 的原因",
            "掌握粘性头部与列表下标的联动"
          ],
          "level": "intermediate",
          "minimal_modules": [
            "render_project_header",
            "render_sticky_header",
            "is_group_collapsed / set_group_expanded",
            "project_header_indices"

          "order": 2,

          "source_files": [
            "crates/sidebar/src/sidebar.rs",
            "crates/sidebar/src/sidebar_tests.rs"
          ],
          "title": "项目分组头与粘性头部渲染",
          "topic": "讲解 render_project_header 与 render_sticky_header：分组标签、运行中/等待线程计数、通知标记、折叠交互，以及粘性头部如何借助 project_header_indices 定位。"
        },
        {
          "action": "new",
          "depends_on": [
            "u4-l2"
          ],
          "filename": "u4-l3-thread-terminal-rows.md",
          "id": "u4-l3",
          "learning_goals": [
            "理解 ThreadItem 组件的组装方式与各徽标含义",
            "掌握标题前缀图标化的两步处理",
            "理解特性开关对 worktree/branch 标签显示的裁剪逻辑"

            "split_leading_icon_char / pick_icon_glyph",

            "crates/sidebar/src/sidebar.rs"

          "title": "线程行与终端行渲染：图标、状态与高亮",

            "u4-l2"

          "filename": "u4-l4-menus-labels-prefetch.md",

          "learning_goals": [

            "理解 DefaultBranchCache 避免菜单打开期间 git I/O 的设计",
            "掌握侧边栏如何复用 worktree_service 创建工作树"

          "minimal_modules": [

            "prefetch_worktree_default_branches",
